items.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
items.description: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.

items.title: What Jensen Huang's return teaches China's Xi about Trump
items.description: Huang being back at the helm of Nvidia is no guarantee of relief for Beijing.

items.title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
items.description: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.

items.title: Gisèle Pelicot 'humiliated' after nude photos sent to media to promote book
items.description: The publisher of an essay on coercive control apologises for "an unfortunate and inappropriate communication".

items.title: India's 'cockroach' party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK
items.description: Saurav Das said that immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him that his passport had been "flagged".

items.title: Israeli air strike kills Hamas internal security chief in Gaza
items.description: Naeem Abu Nahel, who had only been in the position for two months, was targeted in western Gaza City, Gaza's interior ministry says.

items.title: Pope Francis' diary reveals claims he saw the devil three times
items.description: Published extracts from the late pontiff's diary claim one of the visions happened "in the choir loft" during Mass.

items.title: Car bomb tears through Colombian city wounding more than 20
items.description: The explosion is the latest in a string of attacks on buildings housing the security forces and government offices.

items.title: DR Congo says military aircraft missing as rebels claim to shoot down plane
items.description: A South African fighter pilot and a Ugandan officer are reportedly among those aboard the downed plane.

items.title: Russian governor detained in rare criminal case against regional leader
items.description: Andrei Chibis, head of Russia's northern Murmansk region, is the first governor to be detained for five years.

items.title: Iranian authorities flog singer who performed without hijab, lawyers say
items.description: Parastoo Ahmadi, three musicians and a producer were reportedly given 74 lashes in Qom.

items.title: Bangladesh's ex-PM Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return on 16 December
items.description: Hasina has spoken several times of her desire to return, but this is the first time she has set a date.

items.title: Comedian impersonates Trump's dance moves, mocks trade talks at Canada press dinner
items.description: The impersonator, Canadian comedian Mark Critch, poked fun at the US president's search for a new press secretary and US-Canada trade talks.

items.title: King Charles and Elton John pay tribute to Australian music legend Molly Meldrum
items.description: The promoter and broadcaster helped define the music tastes of Australians for decades.

items.title: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling
items.description: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.

items.title: Watch: Moment troops raid home and capture Mexican drug lord
items.description: Newly-released bodycam footage shows the moment troops detained 'El Chapo Isidro', who had managed to evade capture for years.

items.title: Cheers and applause as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia office
items.description: BBC's Lily Jamali reports from Nvidia's headquarters, where she gauges the reaction to Huang's return after Trump says he brokered a deal.

items.title: Outrage after ICE arrest father and daughter at Seattle airport
items.description: ICE officers arrested two passengers, a father and daughter, as they were boarding a flight in Seattle on Saturday.

items.title: First Lady Melania Trump welcomes this year's White House Christmas tree
items.description: The official 2026 White House Christmas tree is an 18-foot fir from Silent Night Evergreens, a farm in Endeavor, Wisconsin.

items.title: Ukraine shares video of strikes on Russian ships off Libya
items.description: President Zelensky said a Russia warship was sunk, with a Russian cargo ship also hit.
